files.name: CH04ED-CH04ED_EN.srt
files.text:
﻿1
00:00:00,725 --> 00:00:08,088
A handheld mirror forgotten in some quiet corner

2
00:00:08,728 --> 00:00:15,704
Movies watched one too many times just to pass the time

3
00:00:16,002 --> 00:00:23,704
Swaying gently with the calm waves on the silent sea

4
00:00:24,024 --> 00:00:31,384
Drifting day by day, until even the sky grows dim and dull

5
00:00:31,679 --> 00:00:39,423
I want to change this stifling future, even if just a little

6
00:00:39,743 --> 00:00:46,911
Taking the very first step with a brand-new spirit

7
00:00:47,501 --> 00:00:55,450
My heart longs for a vivid world

8
00:00:55,450 --> 00:01:02,963
Where musical staffs sketch out a song that's mine alone

9
00:01:03,519 --> 00:01:11,519
Tears welling up in my eyes aren’t from sadness

10
00:01:11,519 --> 00:01:20,287
They’re from the dazzling shine of those stars above

files.name: CH06ED-CH06ED_EN.srt
files.text:
﻿1
00:00:16,125 --> 00:00:22,833
Recalling that distant past, now faded and faint

2
00:00:22,958 --> 00:00:30,041
Melting memories of darkness gently brushed by fingertips

3
00:00:32,750 --> 00:00:40,000
Silent tears slip into the night

4
00:00:40,125 --> 00:00:42,041
the only sign

5
00:00:42,166 --> 00:00:45,916
guiding the road ahead

6
00:00:46,125 --> 00:00:52,958
Tracing an arc of radiance

7
00:00:52,958 --> 00:00:58,833
Our undying feelings overlap once more

8
00:00:58,833 --> 00:01:00,958
Intertwining together

9
00:01:01,125 --> 00:01:16,625
Even if we are lost before dawn, we'll join hands again and again

10
00:01:17,875 --> 00:01:23,333
Two distinct stars, dazzling and entrancing—

11
00:01:23,333 --> 00:01:25,333
Following this trail

12
00:01:25,500 --> 00:01:29,250
I'll keep walking until I reach you

13
00:01:29,375 --> 00:01:35,666
Until I stand beside you

files.name: CH10001Intro1-CH10001Intro1_CNVA_FP_EN.srt
files.text:
﻿1
00:00:42,580 --> 00:00:47,020
Tyrant...

2
00:01:15,420 --> 00:01:18,500
Please be safe and sound...

3
00:01:19,140 --> 00:01:22,210
I have been waiting for this exact moment

4
00:01:23,666 --> 00:01:25,780
... and this rapier was sharpened specifically for you

5
00:01:25,780 --> 00:01:29,780
I'm gonna beat you black and blue!

6
00:01:34,260 --> 00:01:36,580
I wish I could go back in time and do it all over...

7
00:01:36,580 --> 00:01:38,160
I want to apologize for the horrible things I said...

8
00:01:39,130 --> 00:01:42,200
I just want to be with them again—

9
00:01:48,140 --> 00:01:48,540
I hope that from now on, you'll always, always be by my side

10
00:01:48,540 --> 00:01:49,780
I will defeat it right here!
I hope that from now on, you'll always, always be by my side

11
00:01:49,780 --> 00:01:51,600
So how about it? You and me, right here
I will defeat it right here!
I hope that from now on, you'll always, always be by my side

12
00:01:51,600 --> 00:01:52,479
I hope that from now on, you'll always, always be by my side
So how about it? You and me, right here

13
00:01:52,479 --> 00:01:52,860
So how about it? You and me, right here

14
00:01:55,833 --> 00:01:58,041
O mighty God of Grace

15
00:01:58,040 --> 00:02:00,500
Please hear my prayer

files.name: Prologue-Prologue_P4_CNVA_FP_EN.srt
files.text:
﻿1
00:00:02,852 --> 00:00:07,140
Novians often say: "Do not enter the wild."

2
00:00:08,779 --> 00:00:13,300
Thus, most people cling to their peaceful lives in the Cities.

3
00:00:14,088 --> 00:00:19,016
But Trekkers say: "Do not content yourself with life in the Cities."dffd 

4
00:00:20,574 --> 00:00:22,765
Leaving the city walls behind,

5
00:00:24,496 --> 00:00:26,435
climbing Monoliths,

6
00:00:29,343 --> 00:00:31,543
acquiring Artifacts,

7
00:00:33,050 --> 00:00:36,442
and bringing civilization to the Cities,

8
00:00:38,234 --> 00:00:41,538
Trekkers are still regarded as outcasts by ordinary citizens.

9
00:00:42,832 --> 00:00:46,868
However, for them, nothing is more important.

10
00:00:48,228 --> 00:00:57,176
To be a Trekker is to be free and unburdened by others.

11
00:01:00,051 --> 00:01:03,432
As the Cities grew rapidly, history has been conveniently twisted and distorted—

12
00:01:05,756 --> 00:01:10,940
And now, the name of the first Trekker is lost in time.

13
00:01:13,212 --> 00:01:18,140
Yet, when the fated throne is discovered—

14
00:01:20,829 --> 00:01:27,485
A whirlwind of change will sweep over everyone—
